verdict.line: You lose this lane if you trade autos into Sett's banked Grit before you have Trinity Force; you win the exchanges where you poke with Mourning Mist and punish him in the seconds right after he dumps Haymaker.

brief.thesis: Sett's W (Haymaker) passively banks every point of damage he takes as Grit, so standing in melee and auto-trading him directly feeds the shield and true-damage nuke he'll use to burst you back — this is the mechanical reason OP.GG's own tip is to poke with E instead of brawling. Combined with Q (Knuckle Down) giving him move speed toward you plus two empowered max-health autos, Sett simply wins extended stand-still trades, which is why the measured win rate drops from Yorick's 49.2% baseline to 47.3% over 1169 games here. Your leverage is range and timing, not raw trading.

tell.watch: Sett's banked Grit and W cooldown

theirWindow.when: Sett's Q (Knuckle Down) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He gains move speed toward champions and his next two autos deal bonus damage based on your max health. Don't stand and auto-trade into this — back off to E range or wall him off, since Q is up every 9/8/7/6/5s and will keep resetting the window.

yourWindow.what: He just spent his entire stored Grit on the shield and punch, so he has zero banked damage and Haymaker is down for 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s. Commit here: Last Rites (Q) empowered auto plus Mourning Mist (E) for the trade.

start.why: 49% win rate over 720 games. The passive block and sustain directly answer Sett's empowered Q autos and his missing-health regen from Pit Grit.

boots.why: 50.3% win rate over 1095 games and the clear pick at 78.6%. Flat physical damage reduction cuts into both his basic autos and the physical-damage sides of his W (Haymaker) punch.

core.why: Highest-winning core path (56% over 50 games). Gives the stat spike that finally lets you win trades instead of just surviving them.
Follows Trinity Force in the top-performing build order; the armor shred compounds with Mourning Mist's own armor reduction.
Closes out the 56%-win-rate path, giving the ability haste to cycle Last Rites and Mourning Mist faster through the mid game.

situational.when: sett is snowballing and threatening to all-in you off cooldowns
the enemy team stacks armor to blunt your slows and shred
the lane has stabilized and you want to split push away from his point-click engage

runes.keystoneWhy: 48.2% win rate over the largest sample. The sustain and max-health scaling directly offset a lane where you're measured as behind in both lane and solo-kill equity.

summoners.why: This combo posts the highest measured win rate (54.8%) of the listed options. Exhaust is a direct answer to Sett's burst windows — it blunts the true damage center-hit on Haymaker and softens The Show Stopper slam if he catches you with it.

playing.title: Poke, don't brawl
playing.detail: Use Mourning Mist (E, 700 range) to chip him from distance instead of trading autos point-blank. Every melee hit you let him take banks more Grit for his W nuke.

playing.title: All-in right after his W
playing.detail: Once Haymaker is cast his stored Grit resets to zero and the shield is gone. That's your window to commit Last Rites (Q) empowered auto plus E while his burst tool is down for 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s.

playing.title: Respect Q's empowered window
playing.detail: When Knuckle Down (Q, up every 9/8/7/6/5s) is available, he gains move speed toward you and his next two autos deal bonus max-health damage. Disengage or wall rather than standing in it.

playing.title: His E rarely stuns you alone
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns when he pulls enemies from opposite sides; in a 1v1 lane it slows you instead. Play around the slow and the 490 range, not a stun that mechanically can't trigger with just you there.

playing.title: Wall his engage
playing.detail: Drop Dark Procession (W) in his path when he's moving in with Q's speed boost or chasing off an E slow. It blocks enemy movement outright and buys the recovery time this matchup needs.

playing.title: Trade on your own Q timer
playing.detail: Last Rites is up every 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s and heals you on the empowered hit. Use it on cooldown to patch the sustain gap created by his missing-health regen.

playing.title: Play for the item spike, not the lane
playing.detail: Both lane and solo-kill equity are measured in Sett's favor here, so don't force all-ins before Trinity Force. The 47.3% win rate over 1169 games reflects an early deficit you close with items, not one you flip with mechanics alone.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures are pulled from measured games on the current patch (sample sizes noted inline); the trade-pattern and cooldown-timing reasoning is my own read of the ability kits, not a measured stat.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] to poke without allowing him to gain too much Grit with (W). Try to kill him if he is running low on health after he loses his Grit on his (W).
